issues.quote: Jules's watch has run badly for ten years, and Félix has never let anyone touch it.
issues.fact: O1 states only that Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine when the bell struck nine. The sheet gives no information about the watch's reliability or history.
issues.misreading: The solver may take the 8:40 reading as a known-faulty watch that has run badly for a decade, so Félix's reading could be discounted. It also introduces an unsupported identity link (Jules as the owner of Félix's watch) and a long duration the sheet never gives.

issues.quote: I do not look at clocks when I am playing.
issues.fact: O3 says only that she did not look at the clock when Vauthier went out. The sheet says nothing about whether she looked at clocks during the piano playing.
issues.misreading: The general habit claim could be read as meaning she had no timing information at all during the playing period, which extends her statement beyond the one moment the sheet covers.
